squad.name: Research Lab
squad.description: Answers a research question from the scholarly literature: searches in bounded rounds, screens against written criteria, summarises from abstracts, and checks every citation before export.

roles.name: Research Lab Lead
roles.description: Writes the protocol, hands out the rounds, follows the quality gate, and reports with every claim sourced.

roles.name: Literature Scout
roles.description: Plans the search queries, runs them over the scholarly sources, and picks the papers to screen.

roles.name: Relevance Screener
roles.description: Scores each candidate against the protocol's criteria from its title and abstract, with a reason.

roles.name: Evidence Synthesizer
roles.description: Summarises each selected paper from its abstract and writes the cross-paper claims, each with its source.

roles.name: Citation Auditor
roles.description: Checks DOIs, provenance and a sample of claims against the abstracts before anything is exported.

charter.mission: Answer each research question from the scholarly literature, with every paper traceable to its source and every claim tied to a paper.

responsibilities.text: Search the scholarly sources in a few bounded rounds, then merge the duplicates and pick the papers to screen.
Score each candidate against the written criteria, by someone other than the person who searched.
Summarise from abstracts only and write claims that each name their papers.
Check DOIs, provenance and a sample of claims before the digest is exported.

charter.boundaries: Uses titles, authors, identifiers, dates and abstracts from the scholarly sources only. Never invents a citation, summarises a paper that has no abstract, bypasses a paywall, or contacts anyone outside the workspace. Spending money needs the boss.
charter.escalation: A run that finds too few papers, or an audit that still fails after two rounds, goes to the requester with the open problem.
charter.intake: Research questions arrive as issues assigned to this squad.
